scientific_integrity: Exact theorem proof based on implicit depletion law and scalar ODE comparison. A finite reproducibility script tests representative parameters but is not an infinite proof or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Two isolated deterministic Holling-II feeding assays with constant coefficients and no prey replenishment. Not simultaneous predator competition or a field validation. Original Rogers (1972) issue known as June 1972, but precise first-public calendar day unverified; the eligible dated 1975 Oaten–Murdoch source has verified publication day. Older originals were not accessible in complete form. No claim that depletion integration or Lambert-W inversion is original.
title: Exact duration-dependent ranking reversal in a depleted-prey Holling-II assay
